newsitem.title: UK: C&W appoints chief exec of new Panama unit.
newsitem.headline: C&W appoints chief exec of new Panama unit.

text.p: Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc said on Thursday it had appointed Troy Todd, a teacher and former telecoms executive, chief executive of its new Panamanian venture with Instituto Nacional De Telecomunicaciones (INTEL).
C&W's chief executive Richard Brown said Troy, an American, had vast experience in the telecoms industry, in growing businesses and caring for customers and staff.
Todd, who was appointed president and CEO of the United Telephone Company of Florida in 1982 -- a post he held for 10 years -- will be based in Panama City.
C&W bid $652 million to secure a 49 percent stake in INTEL when the group was first privatised in May. The joint venture will be called Cable & Wireless Panama.
